'''Recipes''' is the Van Kush Family Research Institute's index of actual preparations — the things with a procedure, a quantity and a temperature, gathered in one place rather than scattered through the monographs.

Where a preparation is dangerous, the hazard is stated with the method rather than in place of it. That is the Institute's settled position and the reason this page gives quantities: '''withholding preparation detail from someone who is going to proceed anyway is the harm the library exists to prevent.'''

== [[Punic Wax|Punic wax]] — saponified beeswax ==

'''Traditional:'''
* 150&nbsp;g pure beeswax
* Artificial seawater — 42&nbsp;g sodium chloride in 1,200&nbsp;mL water + 30&nbsp;g sodium bicarbonate
* '''Boil three times.''' Faiss's finding is that three boilings raise the melting point from 60&nbsp;°C to 100&nbsp;°C. One does not.

'''Alkali options, mild to strong:''' salt + bicarbonate · wood ash · ash + salt + bicarbonate · vibhuti + salt + bicarbonate · sodalime · potash · lye.

'''Punic milk''' (DE202006013438U1): beeswax + potash (K₂CO₃) + water + sodium water-glass (Na₂SiO₃). Coating, adhesive, impregnant, building and restoration material.

⚠️ '''Stainless steel only''' for the ash and vibhuti methods. Rubber gloves. Vinegar on hand. Alkali burns do not hurt until the damage is done.

== [[Kyphi]] — the Egyptian temple incense ==

A cooked compound of sweet, resinous and spice material. The versions differ between temples and between the classical authors who recorded them (Plutarch, Dioscorides, Galen); the character is constant.

* '''Sweet binding base''' — raisins, wine, honey
* '''Resins''' — frankincense, myrrh, mastic
* '''Pine resin''' and aromatic grasses
* '''Warming spices''' — cinnamon, cardamom

Burned at dusk as a temple offering, worn as perfume, and taken internally as a remedy. The Institute proposes it as the filling of the Amarna [[Head Cone|head cones]] — beeswax shells around a brown-black organic core, confirmed by 2019 spectroscopy — melted by the sun during summer rite. '''That identification is the Institute's hypothesis, not established Egyptology.'''

== Distillation — [[Imphepho]] ==

* '''Method''': steam distillation, which preserves the terpenes
* '''Yield''': 0.15–0.25% v/w — for 113&nbsp;g (¼&nbsp;lb) of dried herb, expect 0.17–0.28&nbsp;mL of oil
* '''Keep the hydrosol.''' It is a usable product for toners and sprays and is normally thrown away by people distilling for oil.

== Vaporisation temperatures ==

The bands are narrow enough that temperature is a formulation decision, not a comfort setting:

{| class="wikitable"
! Fraction !! Temperature !! Found in
|-
| Monoterpenes — α-pinene, 1,8-cineole || 155–175&nbsp;°C (311–347&nbsp;°F) || [[Imphepho]], [[Yin Chen Hao|''Artemisia'']]
|-
| Sesquiterpenes — [[Beta-Caryophyllene|β-caryophyllene]] || 175–200&nbsp;°C (347–392&nbsp;°F) || [[Imphepho]] — the CB2-active fraction
|-
| Scoparone || ~200&nbsp;°C || [[Yin Chen Hao|''Artemisia capillaris'']]
|-
| Flavonoids || 200–230&nbsp;°C (392–446&nbsp;°F) || most herbs
|-
| '''L-DOPA — DEGRADES''' || '''&gt;200&nbsp;°C''' || [[Mucuna Pruriens|Mucuna]]
|}

'''Practical consequences:'''
* '''Imphepho''' is the best candidate in the inventory — it releases cleanly at low temperature and the sesquiterpene band delivers the CB2-active fraction specifically.
* '''[[Mucuna Pruriens|Mucuna]] is not a vaporiser material.''' In a cannabis-and-Mucuna combination the Mucuna is working '''sublingually or orally''' while the cannabis is what is vaporised. Two routes at once, not one preparation.
* Lower temperatures give smoother vapour than combustion on harsh material.

== Aqueous extraction — [[Mucuna Pruriens|Mucuna]] L-DOPA ==

L-DOPA is '''water-soluble''' and '''degrades above 200&nbsp;°C'''. So: water follows water. Aqueous extraction for a VG/PG or tincture carrier; heat is a loss term, not a solvent.

⚠️ '''L-DOPA plus an MAOI is a hypertensive-crisis interaction.''' That includes harmala-containing preparations and syrian rue. See [[Mucuna Pruriens]] before preparing anything from this material.

== [[Cannabinoid Oilahuasca]] — the combination principle ==

Not a recipe so much as the rule the recipes follow: combine cannabinoids with '''[[MAGL]] and [[FAAH]] inhibitors''' so the body's own endocannabinoids persist, rather than adding more agonist — the same structure as DMT plus an MAO inhibitor.

⚠️ '''More inhibition is not better.''' Chronic complete MAGL blockade causes CB1 desensitisation in animal models — the opposite of the intended effect, reached by overshooting it.

== Soap ==

Cold-process saponification is documented in the corpus at `knowledge/soapmaking/` — including the glossary, the regulatory position under FDA and Canadian CNF rules, and the saponification tables. [[Punic Wax|Punic wax]] is the same reaction run on beeswax instead of fat, and on the Institute's reading it came first.
